plain: A person who unlawfully kills another on purpose

webster.text: A person who in possession of his reason, unlawfully kills a human being with premeditated malice.

example.quote: He was a fugitive murderer and an outlaw — a man who commanded an infamous banditti, and at a time when the war was at the most perilous stage.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 7, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
